items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the derived projection formula for a finite morphism of algebraic spaces equipped with sheaves of rings, comparing the derived tensor product with the pushforward of the derived tensor product (statement lines 609-619). The proof uses exactness of the pushforward to represent the functor by the naive pushforward, chooses K-flat resolutions so that the derived tensor products become total complexes, and then reduces to the termwise non-derived projection formula using that the pushforward commutes with direct sums. The reduction through K-flat resolutions is the substance, so the claim is H2.
